title: ANR / UI Thread Deadlock when clicking OK to Resume Pump (`LoopPlugin.handleRunningModeChange`)
body:
**Describe the bug:**
In AAPS 3.4.0.0, the app experiences an immediate freeze and subsequent ANR (Application Not Responding) when attempting to resume a suspended pump. The moment the user clicks "OK" in the resume confirmation dialog, the UI thread blocks completely. 

Analysis of the ANR trace shows a deadlock caused by a synchronous `Single.blockingGet()` call on the Main Thread inside `LoopPlugin.handleRunningModeChange`, which gets stuck waiting on database transactions (`CancelCurrentTemporaryRunningModeIfAnyTransaction`) that are starved for SQLite connections.

**To Reproduce:**
1. Setup AAPS 3.4.0.0 (Fresh install).
2. Set to 'Open Loop' mode.
3. Suspend the pump for 1 hour.
4. Later, click to Resume the pump.
5. Click 'OK' on the confirmation dialog.
6. The app instantly freezes and crashes/disappears (~5 seconds later due to watchdog ANR). 
*(Note: Standard logcat is empty because the UI thread is completely locked before it can flush).*

**Expected behavior:**
The confirmation dialog should dismiss, the running mode should revert to normal asynchronously, and the UI should remain responsive.

**Environment details:**
* **AAPS version:** 3.4.0.0
* **Pump:** Virtual Pump (though trace indicates the bug is in the core Loop/RunningMode logic, likely affecting all pumps)
* **Loop Mode:** Open Loop
* **Android Version:** 14

**Technical Root Cause / Trace Analysis:**
The ANR trace (`reason=6`) shows "Input dispatching timed out". 

**1. The Main Thread is blocked by a `blockingGet()` on line 297 of `LoopPlugin.kt`:**
```text
"main" prio=5 tid=1 Waiting
  ...
  at io.reactivex.rxjava3.internal.observers.BlockingMultiObserver.blockingGet(BlockingMultiObserver.java:86)
  at io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single.blockingGet(Single.java:3645)
  at app.aaps.plugins.aps.loop.LoopPlugin.handleRunningModeChange(LoopPlugin.kt:297)
  at app.aaps.core.interfaces.aps.Loop.handleRunningModeChange$default(Loop.kt:68)
  at app.aaps.ui.dialogs.LoopDialog.onClick(LoopDialog.kt:257)
  ...
  at app.aaps.core.ui.dialogs.OKDialog$$ExternalSyntheticLambda12.onClick(D8$$SyntheticClass:0)
```

**2. Background Rx/DB threads are deadlocked trying to resolve the Running Mode change:**
`RxCachedThreadScheduler-40` is blocked trying to cancel the temporary running mode:
```text
  at io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Maybe.blockingGet(Maybe.java:2862)
  at app.aaps.database.transactions.CancelCurrentTemporaryRunningModeIfAnyTransaction.run$impl_fullRelease(CancelCurrentTemporaryRunningModeIfAnyTransaction.kt:12)
  at app.aaps.database.AppRepository.runTransactionForResult$lambda$0$0(AppRepository.kt:71)
```

Meanwhile, `arch_disk_io_1` is stuck trying to acquire a database connection pool lock for `getTemporaryRunningModeActiveAt`:
```text
  at android.database.sqlite.SQLiteConnectionPool.waitForConnection(SQLiteConnectionPool.java:780)
  at android.database.sqlite.SQLiteConnectionPool.acquireConnection(SQLiteConnectionPool.java:392)
  ...
  at app.aaps.database.daos.RunningModeDao_Impl.getTemporaryRunningModeActiveAt$lambda$0(RunningModeDao_Impl.kt:680)
```

**Attached Files:**

[anr_2026-02-27-18-36-12-141.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25617035/anr_2026-02-27-18-36-12-141.txt)

comments.body:
**Update:**

The issue occured reliable on my son's Umidigi G9A phone.

I then set up AAPS on a Google Pixel 8, and everything worked perfectly. I guess he has a Pixel 8 now. 

It might just be something specific to Umidigi, that model, or just lower-spec / older phones.
AAPS 4 will be fresh new. solving this in 3.4 is not planned. just wait
